sources.text:
Vodno (Macedonian: Водно) is a mountain in North Macedonia. It is located in the northern part of the country, to the southwest of the capital city Skopje. The highest point of the mountain is on Krstovar peak, at 1066 meters and the submontane is at 337 meters (Middle Vodno is on 557 m). In 2002, the Millennium Cross was built on Krstovar peak, a Christian Cross measuring 66 meters tall, to commemorate 2,000 years of Christianity in Macedonia. It is one of the tallest crosses worldwide.


== Climate ==
The climate in Vodno is cold and temperate. Vodno has a significant amount of rainfall during the year. This is true even for the driest month. The average temperature is 23 °C (73 °F). The lowest temperature measured on the mountain, in January 2017, is −24 °C (−11 °F); and the highest measured temperature, in July 2005, is 43 °C (109 °F).


== Hydrography ==
Vodno has a heterogeneous hydrographic web: streams, vaults, waterfalls, springs. Vodno has a lot of streams which are used by the shepherds for feeding their goats and for watering the wild chestnuts.
Vodno has two types of vaults:

Arterial
Well water

In [datierter Quelle] wurde das Millennium-Kreuz auf dem Krstovar-Gipfel gebaut, einem christlichen Kreuz, das 66 Meter hoch ist, um 2000 Jahre Christentum in Mazedonien zu gedenken. Es ist eines der höchsten Kreuze weltweit.
